tests: [pwa.test] PWA installs and uninstalls a PWA
[pwa.test] PWA launches an installed PWA and returns its Page
[pwa.test] PWA launches an installed PWA at an explicit url
[pwa.test] PWA installs a PWA with a standalone display mode
reason: Strider won't add an API to install, launch, or uninstall progressive web apps. Installs, launches, and uninstalls a progressive web app through the browser's PWA CDP domain (installPWA, launchPWA, getPWAState, uninstallPWA). Strider has none of that API; the matrix row is the nearest, a browser-level CDP session, and says nothing of apps
